# Code style

- STY-005: Nullable reference types are on in every project and stay on in every file: no #nullable directive, no null-forgiving operator (!, null!, default!) outside a test project without the comment // CRF-001 safety net: <reason> on its line or the line above, and no hand-written file marked as generated code (a generated name or an <auto-generated> comment) outside an EF Core Migrations folder.
- STY-008: Every publicly visible type and member has an XML documentation comment; test projects (names ending in Tests) are left out.
